findings.highlight: His arms are the next to fall
findings.evidenceJa: その長刀は、二度と拾い上げられる事はない
findings.governingReading: the long sword will never be picked up again
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts the source-free bodily event that Assassin’s arms fall.
Emotional intensity and scarlet color become unsupported physical size and generic red.

findings.governingReading: of the snake, scorpion, or demonic-scorpion kind
findings.explanation: The compound category of abhorrent crawling creatures is narrowed to serpents.
The deathly wax image is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 喉元よりせりあがる悪寒も既にない
findings.governingReading: the chill rising from his throat is already gone
findings.explanation: A vanished internal chill is replaced by mutually conditional claims that breath or blood no longer passes through his throat.

findings.highlight: internal organs no longer serve their original purpose
findings.evidenceJa: 内臓は、もはや別のモノとして機能している
findings.governingReading: his organs now function as something else
findings.explanation: Active alien repurposing is weakened to loss of original function.

findings.evidenceJa: 長刀を持つ事もならない
findings.governingReading: unable even to hold his long sword
findings.explanation: Physical incapacity is changed into possession of no weapon.

findings.evidenceJa: 愛しそうに、或いは蔑むように
findings.governingReading: as though lovingly, or perhaps contemptuously
findings.explanation: Deliberately unresolved opposite readings are fused into one contradictory gesture.

findings.evidenceJa: 涼やかな唇のまま笑み
findings.governingReading: smiles with his lips still cool and composed
findings.explanation: Kojirou’s composed elegance is confused with the waxen pallor described earlier.
The specific denial of self-killing is moralized as loss of an honorable death.

findings.highlight: He smiles, even though he is denied an honorable death
findings.evidenceJa: その血肉を蝕まれてなお微笑む
findings.governingReading: he smiles even while his flesh and blood are being consumed
findings.explanation: The ongoing consumption of Kojirou’s body is omitted.

findings.highlight: His smile is grander than the spawning of this abomination
findings.evidenceJa: その笑みこそが、この異形の生誕を上回る凄絶さ
findings.governingReading: that smile is more ghastly and overwhelming than the abomination’s birth
findings.explanation: Horror and extremity are mistranslated as grandeur.

findings.governingReading: and so, after half a koku
findings.explanation: A specific approximately hour-long duration is generalized.

findings.highlight: finished sipping every last bit of the blood
findings.evidenceJa: 何もかも綺麗に啜り上げ、石段には跡形もなく
findings.governingReading: sipped up everything cleanly, leaving no trace on the stone steps
findings.explanation: Total consumption and the absence of any trace are narrowed to finishing blood.
